chat.title: Chat
chat.subtitle: Talk with your companion. Responses stream in as they are written.
chat.input_hint: Write a message…   Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.empty_hint: Choose a character below. If this is your first time, import a Live2D model and add an AI provider in the settings pages.
chat.no_character_hint: Import a Live2D model in Characters to start a conversation.
chat.no_provider_hint: Add an OpenAI-compatible provider, Ollama or LM Studio in AI Providers.
chat.failed: The reply could not be completed.
chat.delete_confirm: Delete this conversation and all of its messages?
characters.title: Characters
characters.subtitle: Import Live2D models, bind personalities and choose who lives on your desktop.
characters.empty_hint: Import a folder containing a .model3.json file. Ailune checks every referenced texture, motion and expression before adding it.
characters.name: Name
characters.delete_text: Remove “{name}” and its conversations and memories? The model files on disk are not deleted.
characters.activation_failed: The character was saved but could not be shown on the desktop.
characters.import_failed: The model could not be imported.
characters.no_entries: No .model3.json file found in this folder.
characters.copy_hint: Copies only referenced files. Leave unchecked to keep using the original folder.
dialog.import_invalid: Fix the errors below before importing.
dialog.import_copy: Copy model into the Ailune data folder
providers.title: AI Providers
providers.subtitle: Connect cloud APIs or local servers. Keys are stored locally and never shown again.
providers.empty_hint: Add OpenAI, DeepSeek, Zhipu, DashScope, Moonshot, Ollama, LM Studio or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
providers.base_url_hint: Include the API prefix, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.
providers.api_key_stored: A key is stored for this provider.
providers.api_key_keep: Leave blank to keep the stored key. Enter a new key to replace it.
providers.api_key_clear: Leave blank and save to remove the stored key.
providers.extra_hint: Optional JSON object merged into the request body.
providers.delete_text: Remove “{name}” and its stored API key?
providers.no_models: The service did not advertise any models.
providers.invalid_extra: Extra parameters must be a valid JSON object.
providers.security_note: Keys are kept in a file readable only by your user. For stronger isolation, set AILUNE_SECRET_BACKEND=secret-service.
providers.select: Select a provider to edit it.
personality.title: Personality
personality.subtitle: Write the character's inner voice. Each personality can be bound to one or more characters.
personality.name: Name
personality.prompt_hint: Describe how this character thinks, speaks and feels. Keep it focused.
personality.default_locked: The built-in personality cannot be deleted.
personality.delete_text: Characters using “{name}” will fall back to no personality.
personality.character_hint: Assign personalities on the Characters page.
memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Notes that Ailune remembers during conversations with a character.
memory.add_hint: Something worth remembering — a preference, a name, a shared moment…
memory.note: Memories are injected into the system prompt as short notes. Avoid storing sensitive information.
memory.delete_text: This note will no longer be used in conversations.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, desktop behaviour, services and diagnostics.
settings.language_hint: The interface language. The AI reply language is configured per character.
settings.pet_visible: Show the pet on the desktop
settings.pet_click_hint: When enabled, clicks pass through the character. Turn this off from the UI to interact again.
settings.pet_reset_done: The pet will return to the bottom-right corner.
settings.about_text: A customizable AI desktop companion for Linux. Bring your own Live2D models, personalities and language models.
settings.third_party: Live2D Cubism SDK, PyQt6, GTK4 and WebKitGTK have their own licenses. Review them before distributing model assets.
settings.privacy: Chats, characters and provider settings stay on this machine. Cloud providers receive the messages you send.
settings.pet_section_hint: The pet runs as a Wayland layer-shell overlay above tiled windows. Click-through uses a clipped input region.
settings.about_project: Ailune is an early prototype. Live2D rendering currently uses the built-in placeholder until the Cubism SDK is added.
errors.pet_unavailable: The pet shell is not running.
